## Brand & Style

High-end editorial minimalism with glassmorphism for an executive presence in dental healthcare:
precision, surgical cleanliness, quiet confidence. Midnight blue base, layered translucent planes.
(Fixture: trimmed copy of the Stitch project "Visionary Clinical Leadership".)
